description: Fictional customer-support tickets created only for this lab.

tickets.subject: Duplicate subscription charge
tickets.message: I was charged $49 twice for the same monthly subscription this morning. Please reverse the duplicate charge.

tickets.subject: Password reset email never arrives
tickets.message: I requested a password reset two hours ago and tried again twice, but no reset email has arrived. I cannot sign in to my account.

tickets.subject: Mobile app crashes during image upload
tickets.message: Since yesterday's app update, uploading a JPG larger than 5 MB closes the mobile app. Uploading the same file from the desktop site works.

tickets.subject: Dark mode request
tickets.message: Could you add a dark mode? The current interface is difficult to use at night, but everything else is working.

tickets.subject: Entire support team sees 503 errors
tickets.message: All 35 agents in our production workspace receive a 503 error after signing in. Work has stopped, but your public status page still shows all systems operational.

tickets.subject: Need a PDF copy of an invoice
tickets.message: Where can I download last month's invoice as a PDF? I can see the invoice number in billing history but cannot find an export button.

tickets.subject: Dashboard sometimes times out
tickets.message: The analytics dashboard timed out three times today. Retrying usually loads it, but each attempt takes around a minute.

tickets.subject: Billed after confirmed cancellation
tickets.message: Support confirmed my cancellation last month, but I was charged again today. Please stop future charges and refund this payment.

tickets.subject: Weekly email digest suggestion
tickets.message: The new dashboard is excellent. A weekly email digest of the same metrics would save our managers time.

tickets.subject: It is not working
tickets.message: It is not working. Please help.
